history.summary: A BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha mandir dedicated to Lord Swaminarayan, listed on baps.org as the Anand mandir at Goya Talav, Mathiya Chora, Anand. Built of carved stone and marble in traditional style, with a garden, cultural halls and satsang space; Janmashtami and Diwali are celebrated with special devotion (yatradham.org). AMBIGUITY FLAG: several BAPS mandirs exist in and around Anand (Jitodiya Road, Vallabh Vidyanagar listings), and the historic first BAPS mandir at Bochasan (1907, built by Shastriji Maharaj, ~24 km from Anand) is a separate temple in Anand district; the CSV row gives no address, so this file documents the baps.org-listed Anand mandir and the row should be verified against it. The mandir's consecration/founding date was not found in sources - do not treat as known. Coordinates are those of the baps.org Goya Talav listing, approximate.
